claude_output.result:
I fixed it in `build.go`, but I could not run any tests. Every `go test` and `go vet` call was blocked, needing approval.

**Cause:** every build process wrote to the same `outDir/page.tmp`. When two processes ran at once, one could overwrite the other's temp file before its rename. Then the wrong content went out under the other page's name.

**Fix:**
- Each call now makes its own temp file with `os.CreateTemp` inside `outDir`, named like `<name>.*.tmp`. Keeping it in `outDir` means the rename stays on one drive, so it swaps the page in one step.
- The file is flushed to disk before the rename, so a reader sees either the old page or the complete new one, never a half-written page.
- The temp file is set back to 0644, because `CreateTemp` makes files readable only by the owner.
- If any step fails, the temp file is deleted.

I also added `zz_race_test.go`: 400 builds at once across 20 pages, then a check that each page holds its own content and no temp files are left behind. Deleting it was blocked too. Run `go test -count=3 .` to check the fix, then keep the test or delete it.
